MouthLimits.description: How far each control may go on this mouth, after its scale, so it stays whole from every view: a shape asking for more goes only this far. 1 leaves a control free.

wideOut.description: The most it draws its corners out.

wideIn.description: The most it draws its corners in.

smile.description: The most it lifts or drops its corners.

upperLip.description: The most it raises its upper lip.

lowerLip.description: The most it tucks or presses its lower lip.

tongue.description: The most it lifts or puts out its tongue.

MouthScales.description: How much each control does on this mouth: 1 in full, 0 nothing.

MouthShapeValues.description: A spoken shape's controls; each left out takes the style's value, or 0 in a style.

smile.description: Corners up or down, added to the mouth's own smile.

upperLip.description: Raises the upper lip to show the upper teeth.

lowerLip.description: Tucks under the teeth (1) or presses (-1).

tongue.description: Lifts the tongue to the teeth, then out past the lip.

MouthStyle.description: A mouth style: where the line runs, how deep it opens, how much each control does, and the nine spoken shapes.

format.description: The grammar version of the file.

id.description: The name a template's `mouth` and a group's `style` use.

line.description: Where the mouth line runs: front (lips), muzzle (from under the nose back along its sides) or seam (between a beak's halves, which only the jaw opens).

depth.description: How deep a fully open mouth drops its lower lip at its middle, a share of the lip line's width.

carve.description: How deep the head is cut in behind the opening where the lips part, at most, a share of the lip line's width; 0 paints the opening on the surface only.

span.description: How much of the lip line parts, a share of it either side of its middle: 1 for lips, less for a muzzle, whose line runs shut back along its sides.

scale.description: How much each control does on this mouth.

limits.description: How far each control may go on this mouth after its scale, so it stays whole from every view; a character's own style may loosen them.

upperLip.description: How thick the upper lip's band is at its middle, a share of the lip line's width, where the lip line's role has a fill.

lowerLip.description: How thick the lower lip's band is at its middle, a share of the lip line's width, where the lip line's role has a fill.

speaks.description: Whether the spoken shapes move this mouth: false keeps its mouth as its own controls draw it whatever shape is picked, its shapes held as data only.

shapes.description: The nine spoken shapes; a shape left out says nothing but rest.

teeth.description: The teeth preset a mouth of this style starts from (templates/teeth/<name>.teeth.json); none for no teeth.
